_source: peak.mcd.com -- POST /API/Visit/RoipSurvey/<visitId>. See memory/finding-peak-visit-detail-api-2026-09-05.md for the full enumeration chain (Stores/Paged -> Visit/GetStoreDetails/<storeId>?isChecked=true -> RoipSurvey/<visitId>).
_note: Raw, UNMODIFIED RoipSurvey response envelopes -- one per captured visit. scripts/import-peak-visit-detail.mjs reads this file and maps every entry through parsePeakRoipVisit() (src/parsers/graded-visits.js), the same mapper any future interactive path would use. This is an ENRICHMENT-only import: it layers per-question detail onto an EXISTING graded_visits row (matched by loc/visit_date/report_type), it never creates a new row. A visit whose store+date+type has no matching existing row is skipped and reported, not inserted.
_doNotCommitRealData: RoipSurvey's VisitDetails carries real named individuals (auditor, owner-operator, restaurant manager, supervisor) in plaintext until parsePeakRoipVisit()/the import script's tokenizeRows() call tokenizes the auditor name AT IMPORT TIME -- the other names (owner-operator/manager/supervisor) are not currently persisted at all. Real per-question inspector comments are also present. Never commit a version of this file populated with real captured visits. Keep this committed file as the empty shell it is; point PEAK_VISIT_DETAIL_SEED_PATH (env var, see import-peak-visit-detail.mjs) at a local, gitignored/uncommitted file holding real captures instead, and run the import from there.
